import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
def cnt(n):
    N=3*n
    vis=[[False]*3 for _ in range(n)]
    res=0
    def dfs(x,y,k):
        nonlocal res
        if k==N:
            if y==0: res+=1
            return
        for nx,ny in ((x,y-1),(x,y+1),((x+1)%n,y)):
            if 0<=ny<3 and not vis[nx][ny]:
                vis[nx][ny]=True
                dfs(nx,ny,k+1)
                vis[nx][ny]=False
    for x in range(n):
        vis[x][2]=True
        dfs(x,2,1)
        vis[x][2]=False
    return res
for n in range(2,13): print(n,cnt(n))
